comment: Four LIM switches but only three CHK switches, each choking the slot to its right. The per-slot Zoom Waveform, Light Box Color and Light Box Fade items live on each waveform display's own right-click menu, which is a custom widget with no ParamWidget, so they cannot be reached by clicking the display for help; the Global settings submenu on the module's own menu carries the same settings applied to all four slots. The Randomize item only appears once a samples root folder has been chosen.
